hero.title: Need clothes made in Bangladesh?
hero.subtitle: A Dhaka buying house. We find the right factory for you.

about.label: About
about.title: A registered buying house, built for global brands.
about.text: A registered garment buying house in Dhaka, working only for the buyer. You send the tech pack, target price, and compliance requirements. We run the order through our vetted factory network — from first sample to final shipment.

cards.title: Factory Sourcing
cards.text: Direct access to vetted, certified factories

cards.title: Compliance First
cards.text: ACCORD, BSCI, SEDEX, WRAP, GOTS certified partners

cards.title: End-to-End Service

items.title: Transparency First
items.text: Open cost breakdowns at every quote. Buyer-side fee only — nothing taken from the factory. No hidden markups.

items.title: Compliance Without Compromise
items.text: Every factory BSCI or SEDEX certified minimum. Audits managed end-to-end.

items.title: Independent Quality Control
items.text: QC team employed by us — fully independent of factories. AQL 2.5 enforced.

items.title: Your IP, Protected
items.text: Mutual NDAs before any brief. Designs never disclosed without written consent.

services.label: Services
services.title: A full-service apparel sourcing agent in Bangladesh

items.title: Factory Matching & Sourcing
items.text: We match your product to the right factory from our vetted panel — knit, woven, denim, sweater, outerwear, towels.

items.title: Private Label & Product Development
items.text: Tech pack in, approved sample out. Private label and full cut-and-sew programmes. MOQs from 500 units.

items.title: Quality Control & Inspection
items.text: In-house QC independent of the factory. Inline, mid-line and final AQL 2.5 inspections.

items.title: Compliance Management
items.text: WRAP, BSCI, SEDEX, GOTS, OEKO-TEX and Accord factories. Full documentation included.

items.title: Shipping & Documentation
items.text: LC handling, BL, certificate of origin, customs paperwork. FOB, CNF or DDP.

items.title: After-Shipment Support
items.text: Claims, shortage resolution, reorder coordination and account management.

process.label: Concept to Delivery
process.title: Five stages, one accountable team
process.subtitle: How an order moves from brief to shipment. One point of contact, end to end.
